ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-2,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District; RS-3, Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District; RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District;
and RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
16-D in the area bound by:

       East 64th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Kenwood Avenue; South
       Greenwood Avenue; a line 200 feet south of and parallel to East 64th Street; South
       Kenwood Avenue; a line 66.66 feet south of and parallel to East 64th Street; the alley
       next west of and parallel to South Kenwood Avenue; East 64th Street; South Dorchester
       Avenue; East Marquette Road; and South Woodlawn Avenue,

to those of a RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ____________________________
                                                          Jeanette B. Taylor
                                                          Alderwoman, 20th Ward
